Potential loss of disabled customers and non-compliance with digital accessibility guidelines. - **Primary Outreach Contact:** `alembic.investors@alembic.co.in` (`Verified`) ### Executive Overview & Pitch Angle This company currently scores **64/100** on automated WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility testing with **9 identified WCAG violations**. Addressing these compliance barriers will improve digital reach, satisfy regulatory requirements, and protect against accessibility lawsuits. --- ## 💻 Developer & Engineering Technical Breakdown - **Lighthouse A11y Metric:** `64/100` - **Axe-core Rule Engine Status:** Evaluated across Homepage DOM tree. - **Impact Breakdown:** Critical: `3` | Serious: `6` | Moderate: `0` ### Technical Violation Breakdown - 🖼️ **Missing Alt Text:** 3 violations - 🎨 **Color Contrast Failures:** 3 violations - 📝 **Form & Structural Labels:** 0 violations - ⌨️ **Keyboard Navigation & Focus:** 0 violations ### Priority Code Remediation Steps for Developers - **Image Alt Attributes (3 issues):** Add meaningful `alt="..."` text to all `` tags. Use `alt=""` for purely decorative images. - **Color Contrast Ratios (3 issues):** Ensure text contrast against background meets minimum 4.5:1 ratio for normal text and 3:1 for large text. --- ## 1.
